ranks.name: Bronze
ranks.description: Frontline Saints with core Cosmos abilities

ranks.name: Silver
ranks.description: Elite tactical enforcers and temple guardians

ranks.name: Gold
ranks.description: Supreme Masters of the 12 Zodiac Temples

saints.name: Sanctuary Guard Alpha
saints.lore: An unnamed foot soldier of the Sanctuary's standing army. Stationed throughout the holy grounds under the direct command of the Pope, guards like Alpha patrol the perimeter, maintain order, and act as the first line of defense against unauthorized intruders.

saints.name: Sanctuary Guard Beta
saints.lore: A standard-issue Sanctuary guard tasked with surveillance and protecting the lower terraces of the Twelve Temples. Though uninitiated in the mastery of true Cosmos, they maintain watch over the sacred domain during times of peace and war.

saints.name: Seiya
saints.lore: The quintessential Bronze Saint trained by Marin in Sanctuary. He unlocked the true power of his Cosmos to win the Pegasus Cloth, fought through the Galaxian Wars and the Twelve Temples to save Athena, and repeatedly wielded the God Cloth against Hades.

saints.name: Shiryu
saints.lore: Trained at the Rozan Five Old Peaks by the ancient Gold Saint Dohko. Known for possessing the strongest shield and fist among the Bronze Saints, he famously reversed Deathmask's attacks in Yomotsu Hirasaka and blinded himself against Algol's Medusa Shield.

saints.name: Hyoga
saints.comments: He always cries because of his mom's death.
saints.lore: Trained in the frozen wastes of Siberia by Camus of Aquarius. He commands ice-based techniques like the Diamond Dust and Aurora Execution, tied deeply to the tragic memory of his mother trapped beneath the icy waters of the Kara Sea.

saints.name: Shun
saints.lore: Trained on Death Queen Island and Andromeda Island, he possesses one of the most powerful and versatile defenses in the universe through the Andromeda Chain. Despite his immense latent power and gentle, pacifist nature, he harbors a sacred destiny as the true vessel of Hades.

saints.name: Ikki
saints.lore: The lone wolf and strongest of the Bronze Saints, trained on the brutal Death Queen Island. Clad in the Phoenix Cloth—the only Bronze Cloth capable of self-regeneration—he repeatedly rises from the ashes to assist Seiya and his comrades in desperate moments.

saints.name: Marin
saints.lore: A Japanese-born Silver Saint stationed in Sanctuary who served as Seiya's mentor. Her tactical intellect, agility, and mastery of aerial combat guided Seiya through his early trials as a candidate for the Pegasus Cloth.

saints.name: Shaina
saints.lore: Initially hostile toward Seiya after he broke her mask, forcing her to reveal her face. Over time, her feelings evolved into a deep devotion. She played a vital role in protecting Athena and fighting alongside the Bronze Saints during the Sanctuary and Hades arcs.

saints.name: Misty
saints.lore: An elite Silver Saint sent by the Sanctuary to eliminate the rogue Bronze Saints who abused their powers for personal glory. He possessed a powerful air-shield defense that rendered physical attacks useless until Seiya overcame it.

saints.name: Algol
saints.lore: A formidable Silver Saint wielding the legendary Medusa Shield, an artifact capable of turning any living creature that gazes upon it into solid stone. He was defeated only when Shiryu bravely blinded his own eyes to bypass the shield.

saints.name: Orphée
saints.lore: Widely considered the strongest Silver Saint, whose lyre music could enchant both men and gods. He chose to remain in the Underworld alongside his deceased lover Eurydice, later aiding Seiya and Shun in their infiltration of Hades' domain.

saints.name: Mu
saints.lore: The calm and wise Gold Saint of Aries residing at Jamir. He is the master of psychokinesis, teleportation, and the Starlight Extinction. As the only surviving blacksmith capable of repairing damaged Cloths, he played a pivotal role during the Sanctuary and Hades arcs.

saints.name: Aldebaran
saints.lore: The towering Gold Saint of Taurus known as the 'Golden Ox of Sanctuary'. Armed with the devastating Great Horn technique, he harbored a noble spirit and ultimately recognized Seiya's resolve during their duel at the Second Temple.

saints.name: Saga
saints.lore: The Gemini Gold Saint who secretly harbored a dark, dual personality. He assassinated Pope Shion thirteen years before the main storyline, usurped his position, and attempted to kill the infant Athena before being redeemed at the end of the Twelve Houses.

saints.name: Deathmask
saints.lore: A cruel and ruthless Gold Saint who believed that 'might makes right', decorating his temple with the faces of his victims. He was cast down into Yomotsu Hirasaka by Shiryu when his Cancer Gold Cloth abandoned him due to his wicked heart.

saints.name: Aiolia
saints.lore: The younger brother of Aiolos, burdened for years by the stigma of being a traitor's sibling. Once enlightened to the truth of Pope Saga's betrayal, he became a fierce defender of Athena, utilizing his blinding Lightning Bolt and Lightning Plasma attacks.
saints.comments: This ones gets angry all the time

saints.name: Shaka
saints.lore: Revered as the man closest to a god due to his immense spiritual enlightenment. By keeping his eyes closed, he constantly accumulates vast amounts of Cosmos, unleashing it through terrifying techniques like the Tenbu Horin.

saints.name: Dohko
saints.lore: A survivor of the previous Holy War alongside Shion. Blessed by Athena with the Misopethamenos technique, his heart beat only once a day over 243 years while guarding the seal of Hades' 108 Specters at Rozan.

saints.name: Milo
saints.comments: This one destroyed a full island
saints.lore: The fierce Scorpio Gold Saint who utilizes the Scarlet Needle, a series of 15 needle-like strikes that inflict excruciating pain and sensory deprivation on his opponents before the final Antares blow.

saints.name: Aiolos
saints.lore: The righteous Sagittarius Gold Saint branded a traitor after saving the baby Athena from Saga's assassination attempt. Though he died protecting her, his lingering soul and golden bow continue to guide the Bronze Saints in times of peril.

saints.name: Shura
saints.lore: The Capricorn Gold Saint whose arms and legs were blessed by Athena to become as sharp as legendary swords, capable of executing the fatal Excalibur. He fought Shiryu at the Tenth Temple before passing Excalibur to him in remorse.

saints.name: Camus
saints.lore: The master of ice and cold, known as the 'Water and Cold Magician'. He trained Hyoga in Siberia, seeking to teach him true detachment through the ultimate freezing technique, the Aurora Execution.

saints.name: Aphrodite
saints.lore: The Pisces Gold Saint who championed the philosophy that 'might makes right', supporting Saga even after knowing his crimes. He commanded deadly poisoned roses, including the Royal Demon Rose and the Piranhan Rose.
